model.title: Next-Generation Geothermal Research and Development Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee, Science, Space, and Technology Committee · Rep. Pat Harrigan (R-NC)

summary.text: The bill would expand federal geothermal energy research and funding, shifting the focus toward next-generation geothermal systems, including enhanced and closed-loop designs and projects operating at supercritical conditions. It would direct the Energy Department to build a shared public data repository with information from other federal agencies, drill exploration boreholes to map deep heat, and set up a research program with focus areas such as well completion, drilling, sensors, and water use. It would also create a next-generation geothermal center of excellence, offer grants to speed up commercial projects with a federal cost share of no more than 80 percent, authorize $150,000,000 per fiscal year from 2027 through 2031, and require periodic reports to Congress and an updated national geothermal resource assessment.
